features.name: cycle__hilbert_phase
features.description: Hilbert transform phase of the price series in radians, capturing cycle position.

features.name: cycle__dominant_period
features.description: Dominant oscillation period extracted from the trailing-window FFT peak using fixed length.

features.name: cycle__ehlers_filt_output
features.description: Output of the fixed-coefficient Ehlers super-smoother filter applied to price.

features.name: cycle__instantaneous_frequency
features.description: Time-derivative proxy of unwrapped phase evolution indicating cycle velocity.

features.name: cycle__trend_component
features.description: Low-pass filtered trend component of price using fixed trailing window.

features.name: cycle__cycle_component
features.description: High-pass residual isolating the oscillatory component of price.

features.name: cycle__phase_acceleration
features.description: First difference of instantaneous frequency capturing phase acceleration or deceleration.

features.name: cycle__phase_consistency
features.description: Normalized stability score in [0,1] reflecting trailing-phase variance.
